name: An Apple Treat
objectiveText: Progress The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack ... Thunder Applejack  ( 1 )

comments.body:
The drink is from [quest=91736]. Walk up the hill to Thunder Falls in Elwynn Forest's Mirror Lake and hand in 4 [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=4536/shiny-red-apple]apples[/url] to the machine.

An enterprising player can also simply buy a [item=247824] from the Auction House from another enterprising player and complete this quest without ever having to visit Thunder Falls at all... ;-)
